The season began on 24{{nbsp}}July 2026 and is set to end on 30{{nbsp}}May 2027, after the conclusion of the matches of both the championship and relegation round.{{cite web |title=Superliga Datoplaner |url=https://superliga.dk/datoplaner |access-date=28 May 2026 |publisher=Danish Superliga}} [[Aarhus Gymnastikforening|AGF]] entered the season as the defending champions after securing the first title in 40 years in the previous season.{{cite web |last=Jijan |first=Jrah Lafi |title=40 års tørke slut: AGF er dansk mester |website=Bold |date=10 May 2026 |url=https://bold.dk/fodbold/stillinger/superligaen/nyheder/40-ars-torke-slut-agf-er-dansk-mester |language=da |access-date=25 July 2026}} The schedule for the first seven matchdays was released on 3{{nbsp}}June 2026, with a match between [[Viborg FF|Viborg]] and [[Odense Boldklub|OB]] scheduled as the opening fixture.{{cite web |title=Kampprogrammet for Grundspillet 2026/27 er fastlagt |website=3F Superliga |date=3 June 2026 |url=https://superliga.dk/nyheder/kamptidspunkter/2026-2027/kampprogrammet-for-grundspillet-2026-27-er-fastlagt |language=da |access-date=25 July 2026}} The third match day, during the weekend of 8–9 August, was postponed for four teams who were competing in [[UEFA|European competitions]]. The four clubs involved in the decision—AGF, Copenhagen, Midtjylland, Nordsjælland—agreed unanimously to the change to maximise their chances of success in Europe and reduce player fatigue.{{cite web |last=Bech |first=Malthe |title=Nyt tiltag gavner AGF, FCK, FCM og FCN: Klubberne valgte Q3 |website=Bold |date=5 August 2026 |url=https://bold.dk/fodbold/stillinger/superligaen/nyheder/nyt-tiltag-gavner-agf-fck-fcm-og-fcn-klubberne-valgte-q3 |language=da |access-date=9 August 2026}} The postponed games were moved to early September. ==Teams== [[Lyngby Boldklub|Lyngby]] made an immediate return to the [[Danish Superliga|Superliga]] after winning the [[2025–26 Danish 1st Division]].{{cite web |last=Grønborg |first=Matias |date=9 May 2026 |title=Lyngby er tilbage i Superligaen |url=https://bold.dk/fodbold/stillinger/1-division/nyheder/lyngby-er-tilbage-i-superligaen_1 |access-date=14 June 2026 |website=Bold |language=da}} They were joined by [[AC Horsens]] who secured second place.{{cite news |date=31 May 2026 |title=AC Horsens er tilbage i Superligaen |url=https://www.tipsbladet.dk/nyhed/superliga/ac-horsens-er-tilbage-i-superligaen |access-date=14 June 2026 |newspaper=Tipsbladet |language=da |agency=Ritzau}} [[FC Fredericia|Fredericia]] and [[Vejle Boldklub|Vejle]] were both relegated after spending one and three seasons respectively in the Superliga.{{cite news |last=Banke |first=Jesper |date=15 May 2026 |title=Økonomisk bredside rammer
